name: Gordon Ritter
current_role: Founder & General Partner, Emergence Capital; Chairman of the Board, Veeva Systems
profile: San Francisco enterprise-software VC who founded Emergence Capital. He led Emergence's first major investment in Salesforce and backed Veeva Systems in 2008 when it had ~25 employees; he has chaired Veeva's board since, and his Veeva stake underpins his wealth. Earlier he founded Whistle Communications (acquired by IBM).
interesting_fact: He co-founded Software As Service with Marc Benioff, which became the foundation for the Salesforce Platform; Veeva later became the first public company to convert to a Public Benefit Corporation under his chairmanship.
deep_cut_fact: A former Princeton rower, he has summited Denali and run across Switzerland; after IBM bought his startup Whistle Communications he led IBM's $3B Global Small Business division. He recently joined Princeton's Board of Trustees.
notes: Four-time Forbes Midas List member. Best route is via Emergence Capital (Pier 5, San Francisco). Veeva board chair since 2008 per fintool profile.

name: W Craig Jelinek
profile: Career retailer who joined Costco in 1984 as a warehouse manager, rose through operations to EVP merchandising (2004) and president (2010), and succeeded founder Jim Sinegal as CEO in 2012. He stepped down as CEO at the end of 2023 (succeeded by Ron Vachris) and continues on Costco's board; his Costco shares underpin his wealth.
interesting_fact: He started at Costco as a warehouse manager in 1984 and ran the company as CEO for 12 years; in 2019 he received the Committee for Economic Development's Peter G. Peterson Business Statesmanship Award.
deep_cut_fact: Before Costco he cut his teeth at discount chain FedMart, becoming an operations manager in Los Angeles, then moved to Lucky Stores in 1981; he is an Antelope Valley High School (1970) and San Diego State (1975) graduate.
notes: After CEO handover he remained an advisor until April 2024 and still serves on Costco's board (per Wikipedia). No personal channels found; route via Costco corporate (Issaquah, WA).

name: Luan Lin
current_role: General Manager & Director, Kuang-Chi Technologies Co., Ltd. (光启技术), since Dec 2022
profile: Duke-trained (PhD 2010) metamaterials scientist and one of the five Duke/Oxford PhDs who returned with Liu Ruopeng in 2010 to found the Kuang-Chi Institute of Advanced Technology in Shenzhen, forerunner of listed Kuang-Chi Technologies. He has been vice president of the institute since 2010, previously led KuangChi Science, and now runs Kuang-Chi Technologies as GM.
interesting_fact: He was part of the Duke student circle around Liu Ruopeng, whose team published the first broadband metamaterial 'invisibility cloak' paper in Science before returning to China to found Kuang-Chi.
